'''Candleberry''' were [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] served in the [[Jedi Temple refectory/Legends|Jedi Temple Refectory]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They were usually dried and served as side-dishes to dry [[Grain/Legends|grain]].
